title: Fetch the tax tables once, and let checkouts read them without queueing

cases.says: nothing is fetched until the first call; later calls return the same tables without fetching again
a second caller that arrives while the first fetch is running waits for it and gets its tables, and the tax service is called once
once the tables are fetched, a call returns them even while another thread holds the lock
the field that calls read without the lock is volatile, so a caller that sees the reference sees the finished tables

origin.section: Double-Checked Locking Reads Without the Lock, So Its Field Must Be volatile
